name: Stovetop Barley II
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Neutral cooking oil (optional, to reduce foaming)

steps: If desired, rinse barley under running water until water runs clear.
Place the barley in a pot, and add enough water to cover the barley by several inches. Add salt and oil.
Cover, and bring to a boil, skimming any foam that forms.
Boil until barley grains have swelled to 3 times their original size and are a semiopaque white.
